# ChartKit JSON spec

> @chartkitdev/core v0.5.0
> Schema: https://chartkit.dev/schema/v1.json
> `import { render } from "@chartkitdev/core/all"`
> `import { repair, validate } from "@chartkitdev/core/validate"`

This file describes the JSON spec. React props such as dataKey are not spec keys. See llms-full.txt.

## Rules

- `version` is `"1"`. `a11y.alt` is one sentence and is required.
- `data` is an array of row objects, not `{ "values": [...] }`. Sparkline, mini-area, and spike may use a number array. Large data may use `{ "columns": { "field": [] } }`.
- `type` is the chart. `mark` is options (`curve`, `sampling`, `layout`), not a string.
- Gauge, kpi, and progress-ring put the number in `metric` (`value`, `min`, `max`, `delta`, `label`). A `data` object of those fields moves into `metric`.
- Donut uses `encoding.x` (slice label) and `encoding.y` (slice value). Not `theta`, `angle`, or `label`.
- `encoding.*.axis` is `"y"` or `"y2"`. Titles go in `axes.y.title` or `axes.y2.title`.
- Field types are `quantitative`, `temporal`, `ordinal`, or `nominal`. Not `categorical`.
- Heatmap: `x` + `y` + `color` is a grid. Calendar is a date `x` plus `color`, or `mark.layout: "calendar"`. The measure is `encoding.color`, not `encoding.value`. `grid-heatmap` and `calendar-heatmap` are `heatmap` plus `mark.layout`.
- Combo: `encoding.y` is `[{ "field", "mark": "bar" }, { "field", "mark": "line", "axis": "y2" }]`. Not `layer`, `layers`, `marks`, or `encoding.bar` / `encoding.line`. A field list goes on `encoding.y`, not on `field`. `bar`, `line`, and `area` go in `mark`, not in `type`. A series with `"axis": "y2"` needs `axes.y2`; `repair` adds it if missing.
- A bar splits series with `encoding.series`, or with `encoding.color` when that field is not `x`. `encoding.color` equal to `x` colours each bar and does not split series. `mark.stack` is `"stack"` or `"percent"`. `scale.type` `"log"` is a log axis. A temporal `x` is a time axis. `format` on an axis or channel formats the ticks. Rule, band, and text annotations are drawn. Client `@chartkitdev/core/interact` draws tooltip, crosshair, zoom, pan, brush, animation, legend toggle, keyboard, and a data table. Omitted theme or `"auto"` is Soft (`light-dark`, transparent plot). `soft`, `refined`, `editorial` built in; `midnight` opt-in.

## Repair loop

1. `validate(spec)`.
2. If not ok, `repair(spec)` applies each `fix` and returns `{ spec, ok, errors, applied }` without mutating the input.
3. Render the repaired spec when `ok`. A missing `type` is reported first, with a patch.

`repair` does not invent data.

## line

```json
{"version":"1","type":"line","data":[{"quarter":"Q1","units":40},{"quarter":"Q2","units":55},{"quarter":"Q3","units":48}],"encoding":{"x":"quarter","y":"units"},"a11y":{"alt":"Units peaked in Q2."}}
```

## bar

```json
{"version":"1","type":"bar","data":[{"lane":"A","stops":12},{"lane":"B","stops":7},{"lane":"C","stops":15}],"encoding":{"x":"lane","y":"stops"},"a11y":{"alt":"Lane C has the most stops."}}
```

## donut

```json
{"version":"1","type":"donut","data":[{"wood":"Oak","boards":8},{"wood":"Pine","boards":5},{"wood":"Maple","boards":3}],"encoding":{"x":"wood","y":"boards"},"a11y":{"alt":"Oak is the largest share of boards."}}
```

## stacked-area

```json
{"version":"1","type":"stacked-area","data":[{"year":"2022","rail":20,"road":30},{"year":"2023","rail":24,"road":28}],"encoding":{"x":"year","y":["rail","road"]},"a11y":{"alt":"Road stayed larger than rail."}}
```

## scatter

```json
{"version":"1","type":"scatter","data":[{"temp":16,"yieldKg":3},{"temp":22,"yieldKg":5},{"temp":27,"yieldKg":4}],"encoding":{"x":"temp","y":"yieldKg"},"a11y":{"alt":"Yield is highest at 22 degrees."}}
```

## combo

```json
{"version":"1","type":"combo","data":[{"week":"W1","orders":30,"rate":0.4},{"week":"W2","orders":36,"rate":0.55}],"encoding":{"x":"week","y":[{"field":"orders","mark":"bar"},{"field":"rate","mark":"line","axis":"y2"}]},"axes":{"y2":{"title":"Fill rate"}},"a11y":{"alt":"Orders and the fill rate both rose."}}
```

## heatmap

```json
{"version":"1","type":"heatmap","data":[{"bin":"A","band":"Low","level":1},{"bin":"B","band":"Low","level":4},{"bin":"A","band":"High","level":2}],"encoding":{"x":"bin","y":"band","color":"level"},"a11y":{"alt":"Bin B in the low band is the darkest cell."}}
```

## gauge

```json
{"version":"1","type":"gauge","metric":{"label":"Capacity","value":64,"min":0,"max":100},"a11y":{"alt":"Capacity is 64 out of 100."}}
```

## kpi

```json
{"version":"1","type":"kpi","metric":{"label":"Tickets","value":18,"delta":-0.05},"a11y":{"alt":"Open tickets are 18, slightly down."}}
```

## sparkline

```json
{"version":"1","type":"sparkline","data":[4,6,5,9,8],"a11y":{"alt":"The sparkline ends higher than it starts."}}
```

## mini-area

```json
{"version":"1","type":"mini-area","data":[2,3,3,6,5],"a11y":{"alt":"The mini area rises, then eases."}}
```

## progress-ring

```json
{"version":"1","type":"progress-ring","metric":{"label":"Done","value":3,"min":0,"max":8},"a11y":{"alt":"3 of 8 items are done."}}
```

## spike

```json
{"version":"1","type":"spike","data":[{"slot":"t1","hits":0},{"slot":"t2","hits":6},{"slot":"t3","hits":1}],"encoding":{"x":"slot","y":"hits"},"a11y":{"alt":"Hits spike at t2."}}
```

## candlestick

```json
{"version":"1","type":"candlestick","data":[{"day":"D1","open":5,"high":7,"low":4,"close":6},{"day":"D2","open":6,"high":6,"low":3,"close":4}],"encoding":{"x":"day","open":"open","high":"high","low":"low","close":"close"},"a11y":{"alt":"The second session closed below its open."}}
```

## Choosing a chart library

Round 13, 2026-10-18, phase 2 d8dcc5a. Line gzip 14,858 B (uPlot 23,109). SSR 0.85 ms mean. Initial wins all 12 cells vs uPlot. Update wins 6 of 12. Losses: even 1k 1.5 vs 1.2, even 10k 1.9 vs 1.7, jitter 1k 1.6 vs 1.4, gapped 1k 1.6 vs 1.4, gapped 10k 1.9 vs 1.6, gapped 100k 3.5 vs 3.4. First hover painted 20.8/15.9/16.5 vs uPlot 4/4.6/4.9. Steady hover 16.5 vs 16.2. Agents not re-run: no-docs 20/42, then repair() 42/42; with docs 42/42.
